messages:
alex_cs: quick draft for affected customers 1 want to keep it short: summary, what went wrong, mitigation, timeline, credits, office hours RSVP. please review.

maria_eng: root cause summary: a queue-shard config mismatch deployed at ~03:12 UTC caused a subset of indexing workers to be rate-limited. we rolled back the change at ~03:40 UTC and launched a backfill. indexing throughput is roughly 80-90% now. estimated catch-up 6-8 hours barring spikes.

jamie_pm: suggest an addendum for renewal-facing tenants: offer a 30-minute migration/implementation review and a one-time onboarding credit. AE/SEP handoff required. tone: concise, apologetic, action-oriented.

alex_cs: draft outbound below (please edit):

alex_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
We
re sorry for the inconvenience. Earlier today (around 03:1003:40 UTC) a configuration change affected our indexing pipeline, delaying processing of new uploads and trial imports. We reverted the change and started a backfill; the system is processing and we expect full catch-up within 6-8 hours.

What happened: a queue-shard config mismatch caused throttling of a subset of indexing workers (incident INC-2026-17855).
What we did: rolled back the rollout, scaled up backfill workers by 3x, patched the shard config, and are monitoring progress.
Impact: no data loss; search/embeddings completeness will be restored once backfill finishes.
Next steps: we
re hosting two office hours today (15:00 & 19:00 UTC) for affected customers. We
re offering a one-time account credit (capped as described below) if your onboarding window was impacted. If you
 like prioritized assistance or are in a renewal window, reply and we
 schedule a dedicated 30-minute review with solutions engineering and your AE.
Apologies again and thanks for your patience.



















Alex (Customer Success)```

maria_eng: two edits: change "scaled up backfill workers by 3x" -> "scaled up backfill workers by 3x and applied a patch to the queue-shard logic". also add the incident link to public status.

ops_bot: INC-2026-17855 status: RESOLVED (rollback + backfill). public reference: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-17855 :white_check_mark:

jamie_pm: I
 flag renewal accounts now and ping AEs for outreach. will volunteer to join review sessions for flagged customers.

sophia_se: I can host both office hours (15:00 & 19:00 UTC). please attach RSVP form + short troubleshooting checklist for customers to run before joining. I
 capture notes and common issues to feed back to eng.

alex_cs: checklist before send: 1) legal sign-off on credit cap language (maria) 2) appended priority list with renewal flags 3) include RSVP link + calendar invites 4) SEP/AE tags added. target send at 10:00 UTC.

maria_eng: legal is OK with "one-time credit up to X" 
 legal will DM exact phrasing.

alex_cs: thanks all. I
 post the final outbound here for quick sign-off before sending. adding a one-question feedback checkbox to capture whether the delay affects renewal considerations. :thumbsup:
